warnings.desc: DAMAGING WESTERLY WINDS averaging 55 to 65 km/h with peak gusts around 100 km/h are likely in the warning areas, including Hobart, this morning. Damaging winds are expected to clear the state later this morning. Another frontal passage bringing damaging winds to parts of Tasmania is again expected from Sunday morning. Locations which may be affected include Hobart, New Norfolk, Bicheno, Dover, Larapuna and Geeveston. 102 km/h wind gust was recorded at Hobart at 08:00pm on Friday.
